facts.headline: England's Sinking Homes Are an Early Notice of Insurance Climate Risk Withdrawal
facts.summary: The British Geological Survey has mapped millions of homes across London, Essex, and Kent now exposed to subsidence as hotter, drier weather shrinks the ground beneath their foundations. The damage is slow, expensive, and geographically concentrated — exactly the profile underwriters price out first. Read through the collapse frame, sinking houses are an early notice of insurance climate risk withdrawal, posted one cracked wall at a time.
